evidence.jd_authorship: Desarrollar y mantener modelos analíticos en dbt con arquitectura Medallion...Colaborar en el diseño y análisis de A/B Tests, definiendo métricas de éxito
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific named tools and architecture (dbt, Medallion, A/B testing, data catalog) give a precise picture of what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: alinear definiciones de métricas clave con equipos transversales (Ventas, Flota, CX, BI)

evidence.autonomy_level: Optimizar queries, estructuras y procesos para escalar nuestra infraestructura de datos...Realizar análisis ad-hoc

evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: No testing framework, data contracts, or quality ownership is named — only data lineage and catalog consistency are mentioned.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in delivery and capability terms (building models, scaling infrastructure, running experiments) with no risk or compliance register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Desarrollar y mantener modelos analíticos...Optimizar queries, estructuras y procesos para escalar nuestra infraestructura de datos
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mix of developing new analytical models/A-B test infrastructure and optimizing/scaling existing data infrastructure.
evidence.language_gate: Autonomía, comunicación clara con negocio e inglés fluido
